title: feat(studio): Open app returns from the workbench to the running app; the switcher hides kernel packages
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBXim82sEGBUBXqH4hkWyBJX)_

Fixes #34593

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzi3ezPzTysQPDEjmVz — epic: part of #34571.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — locale keys only: three new `@object-ui/i18n` studio keys and the added `{{app}}` variable in `topbar.openAppInStudio`; nothing that worked before is refused (seat ruling, claim 6940874186)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:Studio 工作台顶栏新增「打开应用」，一键回到该包的运行态应用，正在看某个对象时直接落到该对象的列表；包名下拉不再列出任何系统包；运行态只读包的入口从无文字的眼睛改成带文字的「在 Studio 中查看 {应用名}」。
- **为什么改**:从应用进 Studio 有「编辑应用」，回去却要点三次且回不到原对象；下拉里排在最前面的 5 个 `sys.*` 包是不能编辑的系统包；只读入口只有一个眼睛图标，看不出是什么。
- **风险与回滚**:只动前端 `ui/` 与文案，无元数据、无接口改动；回滚即 revert 本 PR。下拉过滤只作用于菜单，入口门禁仍读 `kernel` 标记，行为不变。
- **先看**:`StudioOpenApp.tsx`（落点路径 `studioOpenAppPath`）、`PackageSwitcher.tsx`（`offeredPackages` 与触发器命名仍读全量列表那一行）、`AppHeader.tsx`（只读入口按钮的 className 与文字）。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.openApp-34593.test.tsx`，预期 7 个用例全绿；或在商机列表点「编辑应用」进 Studio，再点「打开应用」，回到商机列表。
- **需要你做的**:无，席位落地。

## What changes

1. **Studio top bar: "Open app"** (`StudioOpenApp`, new). The workbench header gets an "Open app" button that leaves Studio for the package's running app in the same tab, the mirror of the app bar's Edit app. It reads the `?surface=` Studio has in focus (the very target Edit app hands over through `appStudioRoutePath`): `object:NAME` lands on `/apps/APP/NAME` (that object's list), `dashboard|page|report:NAME` on that interface, anything else (or nothing) on the app home. Only published apps are offered (the `list('app')` read the header already makes); a package whose only app is a draft gets no button, the existing Create app slot keeps its place. Several published apps open a picker, each addressed by its app name (ADR-0048's package-id segment only reaches the first app of a package, `appAddressSegment`). Unsaved pillar work asks first through the header's existing `confirmLeavePillar`.
2. **Package switcher hides every kernel package.** `offeredPackages` filters rows tagged `kernel` out of the menu, which now also covers the rows the registry half serves with a flat `scope: system|cloud` (such as `sys.env-artifact-cache`). `parsePackages` keeps those rows and the tag, because `useStudioEntryGate` reads it. The trigger still *names* an open kernel package from the full list (naming is not offering).
   - **Cut: the card's 「显示系统包」 toggle is not built.** Ruling-ref: ADR-0016 §3.8 — "Platform/kernel packages (`scope ∈ {system, cloud}`) remain excluded from the authoring selector — you cannot author into a kernel package." A toggle would put them back into the authoring selector. Acceptance criterion 2's second half ("after the toggle, `sys.*` appears") is therefore not delivered, by ruling.
3. **App bar read-only entry draws with its text.** Ruling-ref: ADR-0146 D5 — "For a read-only package the app switcher row and the app bar entry draw as "Open {app} in Studio" (an eye, not a pencil; zh 「在 Studio 中查看 {app}」)". `topbar.openAppInStudio` now carries `{{app}}` in all ten locales (zh-Hans 「在 Studio 中查看 {{app}}」); the button keeps `max-sm:hidden` and its 44 px phone-band height, the name truncates inside `max-w-[14rem]`.
4. New studio strings `engine.studio.openApp`, `engine.studio.openAppTitle`, `engine.studio.openAppPick` (en, zh — add-only). README section on the app ⇄ Studio bridge updated.

**Two existing pins edited (ADR-0146 D5 is the reason for both):**
- `AppHeader.phoneTargets-29075.test.tsx` — the read-only entry is no longer a square icon button, so its className pin is split from the pencil's: both ids still assert `max-sm:hidden` (intent unchanged: neither Studio button is drawn below `sm`); the eye now asserts `h-8 max-md:h-11` instead of `h-8 w-8 max-md:size-11`.
- `AppHeader.editAppFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx` — the read-only case finds the entry by its D5 app-named text ("Open CRM in Studio") instead of the old aria-label, still proving the eye (not the pencil) and its href; the mock `t` interpolates `{{token}}`.

## Tests

New `StudioDesignSurface.openApp-34593.test.tsx` mounts the real `StudioDesignSurface` over a fetch stub:
- Opportunity in focus → Open app → lands on `/apps/com.example.sales/opportunity` (acceptance 1);
- no surface → app home; two apps → picker, second row → `/apps/service/opportunity`; draft-only app → no button;
- `studioOpenAppPath` mapping for object / dashboard / flow / none / multi-app;
- switcher menu rows are exactly the business package, no flat-kernel row and no "show system" control (acceptance 2); CONTROL: `parsePackages` still returns the flat kernel row tagged `kernel`.

Plus a new describe in `AppHeader.editAppFollowsPackagePosture-12615.test.tsx`: the eye carries visible, non-`sr-only` words "Open CRM in Studio"; CONTROL: the writable package keeps the icon-only pencil.

All readings below were taken at head `4b6267c57` (after merging `origin/main` at `62d9d0d99`), each command run through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` → `Test Files 335 passed (335)`, `Tests 2572 passed (2572)`, VERDICT command-exit 0

- the three touched or new test files, verbose → `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 26 passed (26)`; the new file's 7 cases take 0–191 ms each

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Cut by ruling:** the card's 「显示系统包」 toggle (ADR-0016 §3.8, quoted above). The second half of acceptance criterion 2 is not delivered on purpose.
- **Surface note:** `ui/packages/app-shell/README.md` gained a short section on Open app, the D5 read-only entry and the kernel-free switcher (ui/AGENTS.md rule #2, docs-driven). It sits outside the claim's file list; no other open PR touches it per `overlap-check`.
- **Trigger naming kept:** the switcher's trigger still names an open kernel package from the full listed set; only the menu rows are filtered. A kernel package reached by URL still reads as itself in the chip.
- **New test file, not a shared harness:** `StudioDesignSurface` has no shared harness file (its pins are one file per card), so the Open app pins are a new file.
- **Not browser-verified:** the round trip was proved at the component layer (real `StudioDesignSurface` over a fetch stub). No live staging click-through was run in this PR.
